name: Sakurai Emi
source:
Kanna's younger sister who follows her to the big city.

She’s bubbly and upbeat, but never afraid. She’s still a child, so she doesn’t really understand what’s going on.

[i]”Sis, buy me ice cream! Ice cream!”[/i]
